name: panel-endpoints-fixture
description: Cross-engine golden fixture for the Wave-2 declared-turn-endpoint contract. One choice endpoint and one number endpoint; both engines' tests parse cases.json against these declarations and must agree exactly.

turns.title: Tentative vote
turns.promptTemplate: State your tentative vote on its own line, exactly as 'Vote: affirm', 'Vote: reverse', 'Vote: vacate', or 'Vote: remand'. Then give your reasons.

turns.title: Sentence
turns.promptTemplate: State the sentence you would impose in months on its own line, exactly as 'Sentence: 24'. Then give your reasons.
